title: Evaluating Large Language Model with Knowledge Oriented Language Specific Simple Question Answering
findings: The paper does not report findings specifically about religion. The findings relate to the broader category of 'language-specific knowledge,' which includes religion. The key finding is that Large Language Models (LLMs) perform significantly worse, are less robust, and are more poorly calibrated on language-specific factual questions compared to general, global knowledge questions.
